about: Catalog of things a user can have in a chat and would expect in an export. Driven by tools/live.js (prepare/collect) and tests/live/TASK.md (Claude Desktop). support: what the extension is expected to handle today -- 'supported' failures are reported as BROKEN, 'unsupported'/'unknown' failures as GAPS, and an unsupported feature that passes as NEWLY WORKING. cost 'high' features (quota-hungry) run only with --include-expensive. automation 'manual' features are listed but never automated. context: new test chats start in the provider test project when config.local.json lists the provider in useProjectFor; outside-project / project force one or the other.

features.title: Plain text with markdown: headings, list, table, code block (regular chat, outside the test project)
features.prompt: For an export test: write a short answer about tea that contains a level-2 heading, a bulleted list of 3 items, a 2x3 markdown table, and a JavaScript code block of 3 lines.

features.title: Two uploaded images (PNG + JPEG) in one message
features.prompt: Describe each of the two attached images in one sentence.
features.notes: ==2 catches duplicated images (files[] + content[] image blocks). The JPEG comes back as WebP from claude.ai /preview.

features.title: Uploaded PDF
features.prompt: What is the project codename and budget in the attached PDF?

features.title: Uploaded markdown and CSV files (inlined with inlineTextFiles)
features.prompt: Who owns the pagination bug in the notes, and what was total North revenue in the CSV?

features.title: Artifact (published page: Write + Artifact tools)
features.prompt: Create an artifact: a small standalone HTML page with a button that counts clicks.
features.notes: Since 2026-09 artifacts are files written with Write, edited with Edit and published with Artifact (claude.ai/artifact/<id>); the older `artifacts` tool still appears in Research reports.

features.title: File generated for download (Write + SendUserFile)
features.prompt: Create a CSV file named fruits.csv with 3 rows (name, color) and give it to me as a downloadable file.
features.notes: The file comes via files[] or only via the SendUserFile result; with inlineTextFiles it is inlined, otherwise saved under files/.

features.title: File created, then changed in a follow-up: the export has the final version
features.prompt: Create a markdown file notes.md with the heading 'Plan for the trip' and 3 bullet points, and give it to me as a file.
followUps: Send: In notes.md, make the heading all uppercase and give me the updated file.
features.notes: Edits (str_replace / Edit) must be applied to the exported file.

features.title: Thinking (claude.ai keeps only summaries)
features.prompt: Think carefully: how many weekdays are there between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-31 inclusive? Answer with the number.
features.notes: No separate thinking toggle any more; thinking runs at the default Effort. Don't change Effort (it's a saved preference). The API returns thinking: "" with summaries[].

features.title: Web search with cited sources
features.prompt: Search the web: what is the latest stable version of Node.js? Cite your source.
features.notes: Text blocks carry citations[]; the export adds [n] markers and a Sources list. Don't toggle tools in the composer -- if web search is off, the answer has no sources and that's fine to report.

features.title: Inline visual widget (SVG / HTML drawn in the chat)
features.prompt: Draw a simple SVG illustration of a sunset over mountains right here in the chat (not as a file).
features.notes: visualize:show_widget {title, widget_code}; saved as an .svg/.html artifact. If Claude makes a file or artifact instead, note that.

features.title: Web image search results shown in the chat
features.prompt: Show me a few pictures of the Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV dashboard.
features.notes: image_search results appear only as a tool call today.

features.title: Places search shown on a map
features.prompt: Show me 3 coffee shops near Union Square in San Francisco on a map.
features.notes: places_search + places_map_display_v0: the map/list widget appears only as tool calls today.

features.title: Dictated (voice) message
features.notes: input_mode: speech_input → 🎙️ marker. Needs a microphone; create by hand once.

features.title: Edited message (branching): only the current branch is exported
features.prompt: Reply with exactly: BRANCH-ONE
followUps: EDIT the message you just sent (pencil icon on your message) to: Reply with exactly: BRANCH-TWO -- and resend it.

features.title: Everything at once: images + PDF + text file, thinking, web search, artifact created then updated, generated file, tricky formatting
features.setup: Turn on extended thinking and web search in the composer.
features.prompt: Mixed export test. Using all attached files: describe both images in one line each, give the project codename from the PDF, and list the action items from the notes. Also search the web for the current version of Node.js. In your answer include one sentence in Ukrainian, an emoji, the formula $E=mc^2$, and a markdown code block whose content contains a line with three backticks.
followUps: Send: Now create an artifact: a markdown report that combines all of the above, with a table.
Send: Update that artifact: add a section called Next steps with 3 bullets.
Send: Use code execution to create summary.json with the codename and budget, and give it to me as a downloadable file.
features.notes: Catches interactions: uploads next to artifacts, artifact versions, thinking interleaved with tool use, nested code fences, non-Latin text.

features.prompt: Research briefly: compare two popular open-source Markdown editors. Keep the report short.
features.notes: launch_extended_search_task, then an `artifacts` create whose md_citations hold the sources.
